events.verdict: Marshall (DAL) and Garland (LAC) briefly engage and mutually disengage during the pick.
Jones Jr. (LAC) makes contact with the ball while it is still in the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Jones Jr. (LAC) brings his arm toward Flagg's (DAL) path and marginal contact occurs as he defends Flagg's drive.
Collins (LAC) extends his forearm into Marshall's (DAL) front at the start of his drive and the contact affects his SQBR.
Washington (DAL) is moving alongside Leonard's (LAC) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Washington (DAL) legally contests Leonard's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Gafford (DAL) is already in Jones Jr.'s (LAC) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the screen.
Leonard (LAC) legally contests Washington's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Lopez (LAC) briefly grasps Gafford's (DAL) arm as they engage away from the rebound.
Garland (LAC) begins to lose control of the ball prior to marginal contact occurring from Marshall (DAL).
Dunn (LAC) releases the throw-in prior to 5 seconds elapsing.
Marshall (DAL) aligns alongside Leonard's (LAC) path when marginal contact occurs, which Leonard moves through during his drive.
Miller (LAC) and Gafford (DAL) come together after the conclusion of the pick and marginal contact occurs as both players attempt to disengage.
Miller (LAC) quickly retracts his hand away from Flagg's (DAL) body as he contests the jump shot attempt. The contact that occurs is minimal.
After review, it was confirmed that Washington Jr.'s (DAL) shot was released after the expiration of the game clock.
